Questions 11 and 12(i)

4. The following paragraph addresses Questions 11 and 12(i) which concern Appendix A-17 to the Interim Report.

5. The requested updates are included in the revised Appendix A-17 [FSD(7)/G(III)/1] prepared by the Fire Investigation Team of the FSD (“Team”). Meanwhile, the Team’s findings regarding the severity of fire damage to each of the staircases, lift lobbies and corridors in Wang Fuk Court are now provided at Section 7 of revised Appendix A-17.

Question 12(ii)

6. The following paragraphs address Question 12(ii) which concerns the existence of untenable conditions in each of the staircases, lift lobbies and corridors in Wang Fuk Court during the fire.

7. Since all staircases, lift lobbies and corridors in Wang Fuk Court are connected to the re-entrants of the buildings by opened windows or movable boards, and because the re-entrants are observed to be where the fire spread most rapidly and vigorously, the existence of untenable conditions¹ in the staircases, lift lobbies,

---

¹ According to Clause G6.8 Tenability Criteria of the Fire Safety Code 2011, tenability is normally determined by assessing one or more of the following:  
a. smoke layer height of 2m;  
b. radiated heat transfer of less than 2.5kW/m²;  
c. convected heat transfer, considering the occupant height and smoke temperature;  
d. toxicity, such as Carbon Monoxide concentration not exceeding 1,000ppm;
